# Inspired Creative Group

> AI-powered creative production company in Halifax, Nova Scotia. Video, sound, and design produced by 20+ years of human experience directing 40+ specialized AI agents. AI-Produced. Human-Directed. No shortcuts, no AI slop.

Inspired Creative Group (ICG) produces content for brands and builds custom AI production systems for production teams. Everyone has access to AI tools now. The difference isn't the tools. It's who's directing them.

## What we do

- **Inspired Creative**: video, sound design, original music, and design. All from one production team. Cinematic content and brand systems that make you unmistakable.
- **AI production systems for teams**: custom systems shaped around your workflow, not ours. Your creative directors decide. The system handles the rest. One engagement, three phases: Build, Operate, Maintain (optional). You own the system at the end of it.

## How it works

Every project runs through a production system of 40+ specialized AI agents organized across five layers: strategy, coordination, specialists, verification, and assembly. Agents don't make creative decisions. Our Directors do.

Getting started is simple:

1. Schedule a Discovery Call. Tell us about your project, goals, and timeline.
2. Get your custom production plan, scoped to your budget, brand, and audience.
3. Launch content that connects. On time, on budget.

## Common questions

### What does Inspired Creative Group do?

ICG is a creative production company. Video, sound, design: AI-produced, human-directed. Your story, produced by 20+ years of experience and 40+ AI agents. No shortcuts, no AI slop.

### Where is ICG based and who does it work with?

Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. ICG works with brands across Canada, the US, and the UK, in English and Spanish.

### How is working with ICG different from using AI tools directly?

Everyone has access to AI tools now. The difference isn't the tools. It's who's directing them. AI can't make you feel something. We can.

### Will AI-produced content make my brand look generic?

Generic AI content floods every platform. Without expert direction, AI makes you blend in, not stand out. ICG puts experienced direction back in the centre: in the creative, in the process, and in knowing what "done" actually looks like.

### What services does ICG offer?

Two tracks. Inspired Creative: video, original music, sound design, brand identity, web, and print from one production team. Inspired AI Workflow Consulting: custom AI agent systems designed for how your team actually works.

### Does my team own the AI production system ICG builds?

Yes. No SaaS. Your IP, your infrastructure, your credentials. Your team runs it without ongoing dependency, and ICG's own studio runs on a system built the same way. We produce it. You own it.

### Who founded ICG?

Sandy Peic, Creative Director, whose design leadership spans print and digital visual communications for top tier organizations, and Juan Valencia, Production Director, with over 20 years in audio, music, and video production. Juan built ICG's AI production system, encoding two decades of production experience into workflows that deliver at scale.

### How do I start?

Schedule a Discovery Call at https://inspiredcreativegroupinc.com/contact/. Tell us about your project, goals, and timeline. We'll listen, ask the right questions, and figure out how we can help.
